“अनुसूचित जाति” से अभिप्रेत है, भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 34 के अधीन इस राज्य के संबंध में विनिर्दिष्ट
अनुसूचित जाति;

(छ) “अनुसूचित जनजाति” से अभिप्रेत है, भारत के संविधान के अनुच्छेद 342 के अधीन इस राज्य के संबंध में विनिर्दिष्ट
अनुसूचित जनजाति;

(ज) “अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग” से अभिप्रेत है, राज्य सरकार द्वारा समय-समय पर घोषित अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (गैर-क्रीमी लेयर);

(झ) “भूतपूर्व सैनिक” से अभिप्रेत है, ऐसे व्यक्ति जिन्हें छत्तीसगढ़ भूतपूर्व सैनिक (राज्य की सिविल सेवाओं तथा पदों, तृतीय
श्रेणी और चतुर्थ श्रेणी में रिक्तियों का आरक्षण) नियम, .985 के अनुसार समय-समय पर विनिर्दिष्ट किया गया हो;

“पूर्व अग्निवीर सैनिक” से अभिप्रेत है, ऐसे व्यक्ति जिन्हें छत्तीसगढ़ लोक सेवा (पूर्व अग्निवीर सैनिकों के लिये राज्य की
सिविल सेवाओं में तृतीय श्रेणी पदों में रिक्तियों का आरक्षण) नियम, 2026 के अनुसार समय-समय पर विनिर्दिष्ट किया
गया हो;

© “राज्य” से अभिप्रेत है, छत्तीसगढ़ राज्य;
(ठ) “शासन” से अभिप्रेत है, छत्तीसगढ़ शासन;
(ड) “विभाग” से अभिप्रेत है, छत्तीसगढ़ गृह विभाग;

(ढ) “सेवा” से अभिप्रेत है, तृतीय वर्ग कार्यपालिक के अंतर्गत आने वाले जिला पुलिस कार्यपालिक बल, अपराध अनुसंधान
शाखा, पुलिस प्रशिक्षण शाला, राज्य पुलिस अकादमी, शासकीय रेल पुलिस एवं एम.टी. पूल पुलिस मुख्यालय हेतु
आरक्षक ASN, आरक्षक (चालक) एवं आरक्षक (ट्रेडमैन), जिसमें मोची, धोबी, कुक, नाई, कारपेंटर, वाटर कैरियर,
इलेक्ट्रीशियन, wie, मेसन, डी.आर., टेंट खलासी, टेलर, प्लम्बर, माली, फ्लोवर, आर्म्स, बिगुलर, एम.टी. एवं समय-
समय पर शासन द्वारा स्वीकृत अन्य समकक्ष पद शामिल हैं;

(ण) “विभागीय पदोन्नति समिति” से अभिप्रेत है, अनुसूची-चार के कॉलम 5 के अनुसार नियम i7 के अधीन गठित समिति;

(त) “पात्रता के मापदण्ड” से अभिप्रेत है, अनुसूची-चार के कॉलम 3 के अनुसार आरक्षक से प्रधान आरक्षक एवं प्रधान
आरक्षक से सहायक उप निरीक्षक के पद पर पदोन्नति हेतु दी गई पात्रता की शर्तों को पूर्ण करने वाले कर्मचारी;

(५) “सेवा-अभिलेख का मूल्यांकन” से अभिप्रेत है, अनुसूची-पाँच में यथा उल्लिखित मानकों का मूल्यांकन;
(द) “उत्तम आचरण” एवं “वार्षिक टीप का मूल्यांकन” से अभिप्रेत है, अनुसूची-चार के कॉलम 4 में दिये गये मापदण्ड;

(ध) “पूर्व-पदोन्नति कोर्स” ud “इंडक्शन कोर्स” से अभिप्रेत है, अनुसूची-चार के कॉलम 6 में निर्धारित पी.पी. कोर्स एवं
इंडक्शन कोर्स।

3. विस्तार तथा लागू होना-

छत्तीसगढ़ सिविल सेवा (सेवा की सामान्य शर्तें) नियम, 96 में अन्तर्विष्ट उपबंधों की व्यापकता पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव डाले
बिना, ये नियम सेवा के प्रत्येक सदस्य पर लागू होंगे।

4. सेवा का गठन-
सेवा में निम्नलिखित व्यक्ति होंगे, अर्थात्‌:-
(॥) वे व्यक्ति, जो इन नियमों के प्रारम्भ होने के समय विनिर्दिष्ट पद मूलतः धारण कर रहे हों;
(2) वे व्यक्ति, जो इन नियमों के प्रारम्भ होने के पूर्व सेवा में भर्ती किये गये हों; और
(3) वे व्यक्ति, जो इन नियमों के उपबंधों के अनुसरण में सेवा में भर्ती किये गये हों।
5. वर्गीकरण, वेतनमान इत्यादि-
सेवा का वर्गीकरण तथा उससे संलग्न वेतनमान अनुसूची-एक में विनिर्दिष्ट किये गये अनुसार होगा।

परन्तु शासन सेवा में सम्मिलित पदों की संख्या में समय-समय पर स्थायी अथवा अस्थायी रूप से वृद्धि या कमी कर

10.  Appointing Authority’s decision about the eligibility of candidates shall be final.– The decision of the 
Appointing Authority/Selection Committee about eligibility or ineligibility of any candidate in relation to 
admission to examination/selection shall be final. Any candidates who has not been issued with admission 
certificate, with regard to admission in to examination by the Appointing Authority/Selection Committee, 
shall not be eligible for admission into examination/interview. 
 
11. Direct Recruitment through Competitive Examination /Selection.- (1) Recruitment program shall be 
propagated through advertisement by Police Headquarters/Range Office/Concerned unit. The recruitment 
shall be carried out at District Headquarters in entire State simultaneously at the same time. In case of 
problem of any specific legal order or any other problems, Police Headquarters can make necessary 
amendment in the recruitment program. 
      (2) The advertisement shall be issued on the basis of number of actual vacancies of the posts on the date of 
issuing advertisement. Keeping in view the financial economy, a combined advertisement may be issued by 
Police Headquarters. Arrangements should be made to affix the information regarding vacancies on the 
Notice Board of Superintendent of Police Office, District Collectorate, Tahsil and Block Office, so that the 
information can reach easily to distant rural areas.  
      (3) The actual journey fare shall be paid only to, the candidates of Scheduled Tribes/Scheduled Castes/Other 
Backward Classes categories as per the order of the Government.  
      (4) The posts out of the existing vacancies available for direct recruitment shall be kept reserved for those 
candidates who are the member of Scheduled Tribes/Scheduled Castes/Other Backward Classes categories 
as per the orders or instructions issued from time to time by State Government and as per the provisions of 
Chhattisgarh Lok Seva (Anusuchit Jatiyon, Anusuchit Jan jatiyon Aur Anya Pichhde Vargon ke Liye 
Arakshan) Adhiniyam, 1994 (No. 21 of 1994). 
       (5) Candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes or Other Backward Classes declared by 
the Appointing Authority to be suitable for appointment to the service with due regard to the maintenance of 
efficiency of administration may be appointed to the vacancies reserved for the candidates of Scheduled 
Castes, Scheduled Tribes or Other Backward Classes, as the case may be rule 13.  
      (6) As per the direction of Government, there shall be 30% compartmental and horizontal reservation for 
women. The department may reduce this limit for appointment up to 10% with the prior approval of council 
of ministers.  
      (7) Reservation Roster and Rules, issued by the State Government from time to time for the district, shall be 
applicable for reservation.  
      (8) 15% horizontal and category wise reservation shall be applicable for Sahayak Aarakshak posted in such 
district, where the post of Sahayak Aarakhak is sanctioned.

application or suppresses any factual information, then doing such act shall not entitle the candidates to 
continue in the service or for appointment under the Government and his service shall be immediately shall 
be terminated by the Appointing Authority without any prior notice.

under, namely:- 
(i)  Scrutiny of Applications- Having scrutinized the applications, the candidates fulfilling all the prescribed

shall be computerized as far as possible after the receipt of application forms.  
(ii) Measure of Physical measurement- The physical measurement of the candidates, whose applications and 
the documents after scrutiny have been found correct under the first phase and fulfilling the requisite 
prescribed qualifications, shall be conducted as per sub-clause (a) to (d) of sub-rule (4) of rule 8 (except the 
eye vision test and other tests related to eyes) and the permission letter for appearing into next procedure 
shall be given only those candidates who have been succeeded in physical measurement test. The final 
disposal of the appeal related to physical measurement shall be done immediately as per sub-rule (4) of the 
rule 8. 
(iii) Physical Proficiency Test- Physical proficiency test shall be of total 100 marks and it shall include the 
following competitions:- 
             (a)  Long Jump      : 20 marks 
             (b)  High Jump      : 20 marks 
             (c)  Shot Put           : 20 marks 
             (d) 100 meter race : 20 marks 
             (e) 800 meter race  : 20 marks

candidates of Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes/Other Backward Classes category.

the candidates to take part in all the above said items. On being dissatisfied with his exhibit valuation a 
candidate may appeal before the selection committee, which shall be abrogated spontaneously. The decision 
of selection committee shall be final in this context. The Physical Proficiency Test shall be conducted under 
sufficient light between sunrise and sunset. This test shall not be carried out during night or under artificial 
light.

opportunity to take part in written examination of second phase. All the candidates obtaining equal 
minimum marks shall be eligible to enter in to the next phase, even though if the total number may become 
more than that of 15 times. The written examination shall be of 50 Total Marks and its duration shall be of 2 
hours. The question of General Knowledge, Intellectual Capability, Analysis Capability, Local Geographical 
Structure, Culture, Tradition, Social Values and Arithmetic shall be asked under this which shall be of 
objective type. The written examination may be conducted either on departmental basis or by other agency 
appointed/authorized by the Government.

12. List of candidates recommended by the Selection Committee.– (1) The committee shall forward to the 
Appointing Authority a list arranged in order of merit of the candidates who have qualified by such standards 
as fixed by it and of the candidates belonging to the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward 
Classes who through not qualified by that standard, are declared by the committee to be suitable for 
appointment to the service with due regard to the maintenance of efficiency of administration. The list shall 
also be published for general information.

Service) Rules, 1961, the candidates shall be considered for appointment to the available vacancies in the 
order in which their names appear in the list. A waiting List of 25% of total posts shall also be prepared and 
published apart from the real vacancies by following the rules of reservation, which shall be effective from 
the date of publication till the next selection process starts or for a period of 1 year or whichever is earlier.   
      (3) The inclusion of a candidate's name in the list confers no right to appointment unless the Appointing 
Authority is satisfied, after such inquiry as may be considered necessary, that the candidate is suitable in all 
respect for appointment to the service. 
13. Appointment to the service from the Select List.- (1) Final merit list for direct recruitment of Fighter 
Constable, shall be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in physical proficiency test, written examination 
and bonus marks. The appointment shall be made from the merit list within the availability of posts.  
      (2) The mutual seniority of the candidates obtaining equal marks in total shall be determined on the basis of 
their date of birth. The candidates of higher age shall be considered as senior. If both, the date of birth and the 
obtained marks, are same then the seniority shall be determined on the basis of registration number of the 
application. 
      (3) The Selection List issued by the Appointing Authority shall be valid legally for a duration of 1 year from 
the date of issue of selection list.  
14. Probation and Training.- (1) Character verification shall be done in respect of each selected candidates. A 
successful candidate whose name appears in the Select List (Merit List) shall be appointed on probation of 3 
years, provided that the character verification report is favorable. If any candidates hides any factual 
information in character verification form or give wrong information then he shall be declared as unfit for the 
service and he shall not be granted appointment and if this fact traced out after the appointment in service 
then he may be removed from the service without given any other notice. The candidate shall not be eligible 
to be in appointment and to be in service continuously if his character verification is found adverse and the 
name of such selected persons shall be deleted from the selection list. 
(2) If any candidate, whom an appointment proposal has been sent, does not report within the given date and at 
specified place then the name of such candidate can be deleted from the selection list by the order of Director 
General of Police and the Competent Authority may issue such order that an appointment proposal may be 
issued to that candidate whose name is given just below in the Merit List and otherwise found fit for such 
proposal.  
(3) Before reporting to the unit concerned the candidates has to undergo medical examination, in which it is 
mandatory to be fit fully.  
(4) The prescribed training shall be given in specified training institutes and in other unit after the appointment. 
The training duration may be increased or he may be discharged from the service in case of being 
unsuccessful in prescribed written, oral and practical examination and in case of inability of fulfilling the 
training aims of criteria as prescribed time to time. 
15. Appointment by Promotion.- (1) There shall be constituted a Departmental Promotion Committee 
consisting of the members mentioned in Schedule-IV for making a preliminary selection for promotion of 
eligible candidates.

Section 8 of the Chhattisgarh Lok Seva (Anusuchit Jatiyon, Anusuchit Jan Jatiyon Aur Anya Pichhade

Nagar, Dated 27th August, 2020 issued by the Government of Chhattisgarh.  
     (2) The committee shall meet at intervals ordinarily not exceeding 1 year.  
     (3) The tenure of the committee shall be 1 year from the date of its constitution or until it is reconstituted, 
whichever is earlier. 
     (4) Promotion shall be given according to the provisions of the Chhattisgarh Public Service (Promotion) 
Rules, 2003 and as per the criteria mentioned in the prevailing promotion rules for the equivalent 
post/service in the cadre of district force, GD. 
     (5)    The procedure for promotion in the vacancies shall be as per the rules mentioned in sub-rule (4) and the 
instructions issued by the General Administration Department of the Government from time to time.  
16. Conditions of Eligibility for Promotion.- (1)  The committee shall consider the cases of all persons who on 
the on the first day of January of that year had completed such number of years of service (whether officiating 
or substantive) in the post from which promotion is to be made as specified in column (4) of Schedule-IV and 
are within the zone of consideration in accordance with provision of sub-rule (2).

 Explanation- Method of computation for eligibility for promotion- The period of qualifying service on 1st 
January of the concerned year in which Departmental Promotion Committee is convened shall be counted 
from the calendar year in which the public servant has joined the feeder cadre/part of the service/pay scale of 
the post and not from the date of joining of the cadre/part of the service/pay scale of post.  
     (2) Promotion shall be given according to the provisions of the Chhattisgarh Public Service (Promotion) Rule,

     (3)  Promotion shall be given in accordance with the reservation roster prescribed by the Government.

promotion training shall be mandatory.

shall prepare a list of such persons who fulfill the conditions prescribed in rule 14 above and who are 
considered suitable by the committee for promotion to the service. 
                     Calculation of the number of vacancies for promotion during the relevant year for which the 
promotion process is to be calculated i.e. 1st January to 31st December due to existing and retirement and 
promotion to higher pay scale of higher cadre/part of service/post, vacancies shall be determined by adding 
25% (unforeseen) more than the expected vacancies. Vacant posts shall be decided according to the 
reservation roster.  
      (2)  The said list shall be prepared in according to the provisions of the Chhattisgarh Public Service

in the cadre in District Force G.D. Cadre. The criterion for preparation of select list of person for promotion 
shall be seniority subject to fitness.  
        (3)  At the time of preparation of the select list in accordance with the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (General

of seniority in the service or posts as specified in column (2) of Schedule-IV. 
 Explanation- A person, whose name is included in select list but who is not promoted during the validity of list,

promotion training for promotion of selected officers/employees to higher posts shall conducted in the

promotion shall be given to the vacant posts in the same order in which the name of the suitable employee is 
in the fit list.

to the post of the service cadre in the same order in which their name, as per the provisions of the
